en.title: Upload designs
en.subtitle: Drop your designs, automation does the rest
en.drop.title: Drag your designs here
en.drop.sub: PNG or JPG · up to 500 at once · folders work too
en.steps.title: Automatically, for every design
en.steps.note: Nothing is published on its own; everything goes up as a draft
en.step.title: Title
en.pending.title: Designs waiting in the folder
en.pending.sub: {n} designs · each becomes a draft when you press Start
en.pending.remove: Remove from the list (moved to the archive folder)
en.review.note: {n} designs have a half-made draft or an uncertain result. Check them on Etsy.
en.review.title: Designs to check
en.review.intro: A request went to Etsy for these designs, but the result is uncertain or the draft is incomplete. To avoid a second draft, stallkit never retries them on its own.
en.review.retry_msg: Look at your drafts on Etsy first. If this design already has a draft, trying again creates a second one.
en.upload.title: Uploading
en.upload.known_n: {n} files were made into drafts before and will be skipped
en.upload.too_many: At most {n} files at once; the first {n} were taken.
en.folders.title: How should the folders go in?
en.folders.designs: Every file is its own design
en.folders.designs_sub: Each image gets its own draft and is placed on your mockups.
en.folders.products_sub: The folder's finished photos go into one draft, in file name order (01, 02…).
en.folders.big: Files in folders with more than {n} images go in as separate designs.
en.ready.title: {n} designs ready
en.ready.dry_hint: Prepares and checks every design without creating drafts.
en.ready.junk: {n} designs will be skipped: no product name in the file name, or too many images in the folder.
en.ready.no_mockups: No mockups are turned on: transparent designs go up as the flat design only.
en.ready.no_shipping: The template has no shipping profile: drafts are created, but you need one before publishing.
en.ready.quota: This may need more than your daily Etsy allowance; some of it may wait until tomorrow.
en.blocked.title: Not ready to start
en.blocked.keys: Enter your Etsy keys and connect your shop.
en.blocked.bad_keys: Etsy did not accept your keys.
en.blocked.offline: Etsy cannot be reached. Check your internet connection.
en.blocked.template: Choose the template listing drafts copy their settings from.
en.blocked.template_invalid: The template listing cannot make a draft: {message}
en.blocked.history: upload-history.json cannot be read; stopped to avoid duplicate drafts. Check the file.
en.blocked.locked: An earlier run seems to have stopped halfway. If no other stallkit or 'drop auto' is running, remove the lock.
en.blocked.running: A run is already in progress.
en.blocked.empty: There are no new designs to draft. Drop designs here or add them to the folder.
en.unlock.title: Remove the lock?
en.unlock.msg: The lock stops two runs from creating drafts at the same time. Remove it only if no other stallkit window and no 'stallkit drop auto' is running.
en.run.title: Preparing drafts
en.run.sub: Every design goes through 6 steps · {n} designs at a time
en.run.sub_dry: Every design goes through 5 steps · nothing is sent to Etsy
en.run.stop_msg: No new draft is started; the one being sent finishes. The remaining designs stay in the folder.
en.pipe.title: Pipeline
en.row.title: Writing the title...
en.row.waiting: Waiting its turn to be sent
en.side.title: Title
en.side.empty: No design has been processed yet
en.done.title: {n} drafts sent to Etsy
en.done.sub: None were published · check them and publish the ones you like
en.done.none_sub: The rows show what went wrong; fix it and start again.
en.done.cancelled_sub: The other {left} designs are waiting in the folder; continue whenever you like.
en.done.stopped_sub: {n} drafts sent · the other {left} designs are waiting in the folder
en.done.dry_sub: Nothing was sent to Etsy · create the drafts when you are ready
en.stopped.bad_keys: Etsy did not accept the keys
en.stopped.etsy_down: Etsy is not responding right now
en.problem.junk_name: No product name in the file name — rename the file
en.problem.too_many_images: The folder has {n} images; Etsy takes at most {max}
en.problem.no_images: No images were made — turn on a mockup or drop a finished photo
en.problem.draft_refused: Etsy did not accept the draft
en.problem.draft_uncertain: Result uncertain — check the draft on Etsy
en.warn.no_market_data: No market data; tags come from the file name and the template
en.warn.no_mockups: No mockups turned on; flat design only
en.warn.flat_failed: The flat design could not be made
en.warn.convert_failed: {name} could not be converted for Etsy
en.warn.transparent_photos: {n} transparent files in the folder went up as they are
en.warn.no_shipping_profile: No shipping profile; add one before publishing
en.warn.partial: The draft exists, but an image or an option is missing
en.notify.stopped: The draft run stopped · {n} drafts sent
en.notify.failed: The draft run could not start
en.job.title: Preparing drafts
en.errors.not_image: This file is not an image (PNG or JPG expected).
en.errors.locked: Another run is in progress or stopped halfway.
en.errors.already_drafted: This design already has a draft.
en.pending.sub_one: 1 design · it becomes a draft when you press Start
en.review.note_one: 1 design has a half-made draft or an uncertain result. Check it on Etsy.
en.upload.known_n_one: 1 file was made into a draft before and will be skipped
en.ready.junk_one: 1 design will be skipped: no product name in the file name, or too many images in the folder.
en.notify.stopped_one: The draft run stopped · 1 draft sent
en.blocked.junk_only: No product name can be read from the waiting designs' file names. Rename them to say what they are (for example retro-mountain-sunset.png).
en.errors.template_gone: The template listing is no longer on Etsy. Choose a new one on the Template listing page.
en.chip.mockup_hint: Choose which mockups are used, and in which order, on the Mockups page. Etsy allows at most 20 images per listing (1 is the flat design).
en.ready.mockups_over: The first {n} of {on} switched-on mockups will be used — Etsy allows at most 20 images per listing (1 is the flat design).
en.errors.too_many_pixels: Too large: {width}×{height} px. Images can be at most {max_edge} px on a side and {max_mp} million pixels; make it smaller and upload it again.
